extracted.name: Watermelon Popsicles
extracted.description: We love to make these 2-ingredient watermelon popsicles all summer long! The perfect treat for a hot day, they're icy, fruity, and refreshing. Vegan and gluten-free.
instruction_lines: In a blender, place the watermelon and lime juice. Blend until completely smooth, then pour into popsicle molds, leaving ½ inch at the top for expansion.
Cover and add popsicle sticks if necessary. Freeze until set, 4 hours or overnight.
